breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses τ_max = √[(σ_avg/2)² + τ_avg²], which includes both the normal stress and shear stress contributions to the maximum in-plane shear stress. This matches the ground truth and removes the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt that said to take the maximum in-plane shear as the average transverse shear stress alone.
